applicableAreas: Valley View Road street frontage, street yard planting areas (H-2, H-3 zones)
findings.comment: Street trees are shown in the ROW street yard area along Valley View Road on the landscape plan, but no designated planting zones (with marked root barrier boundaries positioned 7 feet from tree trunks per UCM § 2.9.1.C) are explicitly shown. Cannot verify whether Austin Water mains or services are proposed within these street tree zones, or whether the required 8-foot minimum Utility Gap width is maintained between planting zones. Planting zone designations (root barriers and Utility Gap markings) must be clearly depicted on the landscape plan to verify compliance with UCM § 2.9.1.C.

applicableAreas: NE portion of site, NE corner and NE interior (Unit 501, detention pond area)
findings.comment: Two critical recorded utility easements are not depicted on the submitted site plan: (1) Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731, filed 2010-05-18) covering 0.31 acres in the NE interior as a perpetual no-build zone, and (2) City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137, filed 2011-02-11) covering 0.130 acres in the NE corner with unlimited City access rights. Together these encumber approximately 19% of the site's NE area. Without their depicted boundaries, compliance cannot be verified for items (structures, paving, landscaping, retaining walls) that may be proposed within these easement boundaries. License Agreements per UCM § 1.10.10.3 (for private AE easements) or City Manager licenses per § 14-11-41 (for public easements) cannot be confirmed. Add easement boundaries to site plan or provide documentation of relocation/modification/licensing.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations: west of Bldg. 2, between Bldgs. 4/5, between Bldgs. 6/7, and west of Bldg. 8
findings.comment: Four transformer pads are shown on the electrical site plan, but required clearances and easement documentation are not fully verified. Only one pad (near Bldg. 8) displays a visible 'Vault Easement' label; the other three pads lack visible Austin Energy easement encumbrances required per UCM § 1.10.10.3. Specific clearance dimensions per UCM § 1.10.4 (10 feet from any adjacent building on hot-stick side; 3 feet on non-operator sides; 5 feet on operator/control sides; pad within 6 feet of parking or traffic area; 2 feet from back of sidewalks) are not dimensioned on this plan. AE truck access requirements per UCM § 1.3.16 (12-foot horizontal width, 16-foot vertical clearance, 20×35 foot set-up area) cannot be verified from the site plan. Provide transformer pad sizing per AE Design specifications, clearly mark all AE easement boundaries for all four pads, dimension clearances per UCM § 1.10.4, and verify truck access paths meet UCM § 1.3.16 or provide Austin Energy coordination documentation.
